summary: 790 Pretoria is a minor planet orbiting the Sun. It was discovered by English astronomer Harry Edwin Wood on January 16, 1912. The note states it belongs to the Cybele group, located beyond the core of the main asteroid belt.
one_line: 790 Pretoria is a minor planet discovered by Harry Edwin Wood in 1912 and classified in the Cybele group beyond the main belt core.
key_facts: 790 Pretoria is a minor planet orbiting the Sun.
790 Pretoria was discovered by English astronomer Harry Edwin Wood.
790 Pretoria is a member of the Cybele group.
The Cybele group is located beyond the core of the main belt.
